definitions.gloss: salary cut, pay reduction, wage decrease
definitions.explanation: A reduction in an employee's salary, either as a disciplinary measure or due to company financial difficulties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不祥事|ふしょうじ}→不祥事：14981_fushouji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{減給|げんきゅう}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My salary was cut due to misconduct.

examples.japanese: {減給|げんきゅう}⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I received a salary reduction as punishment.

examples.japanese: {業績悪化|ぎょうせきあっか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{全社員|ぜんしゃいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{減給|げんきゅう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: All employees had their salaries cut due to poor company performance.

notes:
FORMS:
{減|げん} (reduce, decrease) + {給|きゅう} (salary, pay)

USAGE:
1. As disciplinary action ({懲戒処分|ちょうかいしょぶん})
2. Due to company financial difficulties
3. Voluntary pay cuts by executives

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {減給|げんきゅう}⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧ (salary cut as disciplinary action)
- {減給|げんきゅう}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to have one's salary cut)
- {減給|げんきゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じる→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧ (to accept a pay cut)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{昇給|しょうきゅう}→昇給：04687_shoukyuu⟧: salary increase (opposite)
- ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧: salary
- ⟦{懲戒|ちょうかい}→懲戒：09469_choukai⟧: disciplinary action
- ⟦{降格|こうかく}→降格：04688_koukaku⟧: demotion
